title: Before you start: the Python you need
description: DSA lessons are written in Python. If you can read these 15 lessons, no syntax in this roadmap will surprise you. This is a recommendation, not a lock — skip anything you already know.

lessons.why: int, float, str, bool — the values every trace shows
int('5'), str(5) — input parsing in every problem
for/while — the body of every algorithm
every solution is a function taking inputs
THE array — the most used structure in DSA
immutable sequences — half of easy problems are strings
arr[1:], arr[::-1] — you'll see these in lesson one
the hash map — the #1 interview data structure
the loop idioms all DSA code is written in
sort by a key — intervals, pairs, custom order
one-line transforms — you'll read them constantly
